title: Taking up piano and dreaming of baseball
summary: His sister urges him to learn music and he starts piano, but his dream is big-league baseball even though he cannot run.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Taft, Oklahoma. A black town, an all colored town nine miles from Muskogee. That was the largest town near. Later on, I will get to it, Muskogee played a big part in my career too. But anyway, I would walk and walk to hear these things, so finally my sister began to say, you like music so, why don't you learn to do something yourself. So I began to play piano. But as I got older, I fell in a little with baseball, and that was my dream, to be a
big league baseball player. All through junior high school I was playing good in everything but running. No coach or teacher could teach me to run, I couldn't run.
